transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble at work lately. I manage production at a plant and... well, I went from doing a lot—launching all these redesign projects non-stop, calling suppliers after hours, rewriting the entire shift plan by myself—to... suddenly just not being able to keep up with any of the plans I set in motion. So... yeah. That's why I came in.
During that period when you were launching projects non-stop, did you need much less sleep than usual?

Yeah... I guess so. Um, I was maybe getting... two or three hours a night. But it was fine. I'd still show up at the plant feeling sharp and... charged, I guess. It just seemed like sleep was sort of optional at the time. Like it was just... inefficient.
During that time, did you feel unusually high or euphoric?

Um... I don't know about euphoric. I guess... at the beginning of all those projects, I did feel... I don't know, almost electrically upbeat. 

But... mostly I just got weirdly irritable after a while. Like, if anyone questioned my ideas, it just felt like they were slowing down something that was obvious and important. So... yeah. Just... irritable, mostly.
During that energized and irritable period, did it cause serious problems at work or in your life?

Um... yeah, I suppose so. I mean... I actually had to ask to leave a shift-planning meeting recently. And... well, occupational health got involved. I just... I couldn't make the basic production decisions I'm supposed to make. So... yeah, it became an issue.
During that energized and irritable period, did you have beliefs that other people said were unrealistic or not true?

Um... I guess some people thought so. I just... we had this whole consulting team looking at the production workflow, and... I honestly believed I could just fix the entire thing myself. Faster than them. 

People brought up concerns about it, but I... I kind of just brushed them off. I didn't really see how I could be wrong. Like... failure didn't even seem possible to me at the time. So... yeah. I guess they thought that was unrealistic.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Um... yeah. Lately, I guess. 

I just... I wake up in the temporary apartment, and... I don't know, there's just this heavy, hollow feeling. Like the day is already ruined before I even drive to the plant. So... yeah. Most days are like that right now.
During this recent low period, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Um... I don't know. I guess I don't really do much outside of work right now anyway. I just go back to the apartment. I haven't really thought about it.
During this recent low period, have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living?
Um... no. I haven't really thought about that. I just... I just feel tired, mostly.
During this recent low period, have you lost interest in things you would usually enjoy?
I think you just asked me that. Like I said, I... I don't really do much right now anyway. So I guess I don't know.
During that high-energy period, did you hear or see things that other people said were not there?
Um... no. I didn't experience anything like that. Just... no.
Before this recent low period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day for at least two weeks?
I... I don't really know. I haven't kept track of things like that. Um... I don't think so.
Before this recent high-energy period, have you ever had another time in your life when you felt unusually energized or needed much less sleep than usual?
I don't think so. Um... no, not that I can remember. Probably just this once.
Did this low period start only after the high-energy period ended?
Um... I suppose so. I wasn't really keeping track of exactly when one stopped and the other started. It just... happened.
During this recent low period, was there a time when you felt down or depressed nearly all day, almost every day, for at least two weeks?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's been at least a couple of weeks. Lately, I just... I wake up in my temporary apartment with this heavy, hollow feeling. It's like the day is already ruined before I even drive to the plant. So... yes.
During this recent low period, have you lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really noticed. I don't do much besides work anyway, so... I'm not really sure.
During this recent low period, have you had much less energy than usual?

Um... I don't think so. I mean, I still get up and go to the plant every day. I might be a little tired, but... I haven't really noticed a huge drop in my energy or anything. I just... do what I have to do.
During this recent low period, have you been having trouble concentrating or making decisions?

Um... yeah. I guess I have. Like... we had this shift-planning meeting recently, and... I don't know. I just couldn't hold the staffing numbers in my head long enough to make a basic decision. It's... it's terrifying, honestly. Because that's normally exactly my job.
During this recent low period, have you had a clear decrease in your appetite?

Um... I guess my eating is just... kind of all over the place. Sometimes it's like four in the afternoon and I realize I've only had coffee all day. But then... other times I'm just standing in the kitchen eating takeout right out of the box. Even when I'm not really hungry. I don't know. It's just... messy, I guess.
During this recent low period, have you been sleeping much more or much less than usual?

Um... less, I guess. I just... I lie awake for hours sometimes. Just... replaying mistakes from work in my head. Or I'll wake up around 3 or 4 in the morning and... I just can't get back to sleep. So I end up kind of... dragging through the day like I never rested at all.
During this recent low period, have you been feeling unusually guilty or worthless?
Um... no. I don't... I don't think I've felt like that. Not really.
